Timing

Choose Words or Hazzat above, then select its recording below. Start aligning and use ← and → with Space, or tap a part directly to mark its time.

Keep my manual timings as a reference

Optional: guide a phrase match

Automatic search runs without these ranges. To guide a difficult match, choose the same beginning and ending in both recordings, excluding the spoken intro. Split at changed repeats or omitted sections. Each range can be up to 90 seconds.

Choose a reviewed reference. Unfamiliar melodies need a compatible reference before they can be aligned.
